query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!: i64" FROM audit_log a
               WHERE (? = '' OR a.actor_type = ?)
                 AND (? = '' OR a.actor_id = ?)
                 AND (? = '' OR a.action = ? OR a.action LIKE ? ESCAPE '\')
                 AND (? = '' OR a.target_type = ?)
                 AND (? = '' OR a.target_id = ?)
                 AND (? = '' OR a.at >= ?)
                 AND (? = '' OR a.at < ?)
